title: Controlled Evaluation of Syntactic Knowledge in Multilingual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Targeted syntactic evaluation (TSE) using minimal pairs to compare model-assigned probabilities of grammatically acceptable versus unacceptable sequences across low-resource languages (Basque, Hindi, and Swahili), specifically identifying syntactic performance disparities and statistical model biases (e.g., an unwarranted algorithmic bias toward the habitual aspect in Hindi).
